_comment: Hand-labelled ground truth. `live` is the answer a careful reviewer gives with the whole corpus in front of them, and `why` is the evidence — a label without one is an opinion. Edit only with a reason recorded here.
notes: The only fixture with genuinely dead symbols, so the only one that can measure recall. `cycle_a`/`cycle_b` are the abandoned-cycle shape: each has an inbound edge from the other, so the one-hop liveness join cannot see them and they are reported by the dead-cluster pass instead, at the `inferred` tier. Scoring the two lists together is what makes recall meaningful here.

symbols.why: Public member of an `__all__`-exported class: deleting it breaks the declared API even though nothing in the corpus calls it.
Underscore-private by convention and exempt before the verdict runs; labelled live so a regression that started reporting it shows up as a false positive.
Module-level, absent from `__all__`, and called by nothing.
Reachable only from cycle_b, which is itself unreachable.
The other half of the abandoned cycle.
